content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: on the cap / floor form, each Save click returns a visible error (app:52, app:66, app:80, each after a Save at 325, 374, 423), and each attempt then restarts with a return to the Notional field (focus 308, 347, 396, followed by keystrokes 351, 400), which suggests Notional is the field the validation is pointing at, though the events do not show the error text or which field it refers to.", "fix": "Fix: on the cap / floor form, validate the Notional input on blur and show its error message inline beneath the Notional field, so the problem is flagged before Save is clicked and the Save-time error no longer requires returning to Notional.", "cited_event_ids": ["308", "347", "351", "396", "400", "325", "374", "423", "app:52", "app:66", "app:80", "app:83:success"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["Error message text and the field it targets are not in the events (error events carry only 'visible').", "Values entered in Notional are masked, so whether the value is invalid cannot be verified.", "Earlier error events on Trade Date and Counterparty (49:a54, 54:a62, 290:a335) are not tied to Notional and were not used as the cause.", "Whether the error appears after Save only or also on other actions is not shown beyond these windows.", "The 258 dropped pointer samples mean pointer-level detail is incomplete.", "Facts give no time lost (median 0) and no abandonment; the fix is inferred from timing, not confirmed."]}
